prompt_editor.title: Custom Grading Prompt
prompt_editor.default_prompt:
When grading, please focus on:
1. Thesis & content: whether the argument is clear and the material is relevant and substantial
2. Structure & logic: whether paragraph transitions and argumentation are coherent
3. Language: word precision, sentence variety, and expressiveness
4. Highlights: point out strengths worth keeping and developing

Make suggestions specific and actionable; avoid generic comments.

sample.topic: Write an argumentative essay of at least 300 words on the topic of "Perseverance".
sample.content:
The Power of Perseverance

Great achievements are rarely born of sudden inspiration. More often, they grow from countless ordinary days of quiet, stubborn effort. Perseverance is the bridge between what we dream of and what we actually accomplish.

History offers abundant proof. Thomas Edison tested thousands of materials before finding a workable filament for the light bulb. Marie Curie spent years processing tons of ore to isolate a fraction of a gram of radium. Neither talent alone nor luck alone carried them forward; it was their refusal to stop.

Yet perseverance is not the same as stubbornness. True persistence means holding firmly to a worthy goal while remaining willing to adjust the path. When the direction is wrong, pausing to reflect is itself progress; when the direction is right, even slow steps will arrive.

For young people today, the lesson is simple: time rewards those who keep going. May we all treat perseverance as our sail and conviction as our oar, and press forward steadily through the long river of life.
